verdict: PASS for publication as a bounded research harness; real-receipt end-to-end execution and proof-cost qualification remain pending.
reviewed_scope: All public/worker/verifier entry points; fixed E owner source pin and copied source identity; frame parser and transfer; held-file hash identities; both actual-host verification calls; cancellation and waitid/WNOWAIT/kill-before-wait4 ownership; numeric/resource bounds and failure reporting.

Expected verifier host SHA-256 is an explicit caller trust input, permitted to differ from the original prover host; both digests and same_host_binary_as_prover are reported. The harness does not compile, attest, or establish that caller trust.

Only a trusted actual verifier success before network and a second trusted verifier success on retained received bytes can set qualified_cost. Missing artifact, no receipt, nonzero verifier, cancellation, timeout, incomplete cleanup, or a failed case keeps it null/failed.
Frame is separate PWCO0001 Composite research transport; it does not claim compatibility with Succinct PWAI0001, ordinary PoN admission, or WAN cost.
Outer E process-group owner reserves leader until SIGKILL then wait4; internal verifier remains in that group and does not call start_new_session. Default SIGCHLD is enforced.
Persistent cancellation at every original work-deadline safe point survives the samplers OSError catch; separate cleanup deadline remains operational; original E owner bytes unchanged.
